subject: 英语
source: 人教版(PEP)小学英语（三年级起点，3-6年级）语法与功能句型体系
original_text: 序数词：first(1st), second(2nd), third(3rd), fourth(4th)... twentieth(20th), twenty-first(21st), twenty-second(22nd)。日期表达：May 1st, June 3rd。句型：When is your birthday? — It's on May 1st.
key_points: 序数词：first(1st), second, third, fifth, twelfth...
formulas: 示例：When is your birthday? It's on May 2nd.
cautions: ①序数词前通常加 the（如 the first, the second）；②日期用序数词而非基数词（June 3rd 非 June 3）；③21st/22nd 等拼写为 twenty-first / twenty-second（勿漏连字符）；④first/second/third 特殊拼写。
